midshotsToday.terms: 16 declared · 3 places at 1/4 odds under tracker policy
midshotsToday.reason: One of the better 10/1–18/1 place profiles: form 143252 includes several recent top-three finishes. RPR94 compared with OR80 offers a useful ratings angle; low weight and experienced Silvestre De Sousa in a valuable York 7f novice event.
midshotsToday.risk: Sixteen-runner juvenile race is inherently unpredictable. Ground listed good with good-to-soft patches; race pace and position may decide the outcome. A place possibility, not a high-probability winner.

midshotsToday.terms: 11 declared · 3 places at 1/4 odds under tracker policy
midshotsToday.reason: The price allows an each-way case rather than a strict win expectation. RPR112 tops OR96; an expected improvement from a breathing intervention and the longer 1m4f trip could change a recent disappointing finishing profile. Rossa Ryan booked.
midshotsToday.risk: Recent form 4-5496 is poor; the breathing operation and trip improvement are theories, not verified positives. This is the weakest of the shortlist and should be withdrawn if the market or conditions worsen.

longshotsToday.terms: Eight declared · top three at 1/4 odds under tracker policy
longshotsToday.reason: Among big-priced runners, a relatively credible place case: form 341223 shows repeated top-three finishes at strong level, RPR112, and a stepping-back-up-to-a-mile argument. Racing TV's analyst also notes consistency and a good-value outsider profile.
longshotsToday.risk: Same race as dominant favourite Musical Times; winning chances are low and even third place is uncertain in Group 1 company. This is a place-oriented longshot, NOT a high-confidence win selection.

lucky15Only.reason: Reasonable 5f Group 3 place profile at around 5/2: RPR113, winner twice before recent third and William Buick booking. Kept as a ticket leg instead of adding another £10 individual bet.
lucky15Only.risk: Group 3 sprint with 13 starters; 5f pace and draw can produce sizeable reversals.

midshotsPolicy.publicNote: Small, disciplined 10/1–18/1 each-way shortlist. These are lower-probability selections than the win picks, despite form-based place appeal.
midshotsPolicy.priceRule: Only take an unambiguous 10/1–18/1 quote; recheck declared field, market and going.

longshotsPolicy.publicNote: Only one speculative 20/1+ contender retained; this is NOT a high-confidence win pick. Strong place appeal at a long price is possible without high absolute probability.
longshotsPolicy.priceRule: No longshot bet if quoted under 20/1 or fewer than 8 runners after non-runners; reassess paid places.

selectionPolicy.scope: Current day's selective shortlist only. Previous paper bets and results remain in permanent ledger and archived racecard.
selectionPolicy.reviewRequired: Recheck going, non-runners, weight/draw and market within one hour of scheduled off time
selectionPolicy.confidenceNote: Qualitative research confidence, not backtested/calibrated probabilities.

lucky15Plan.terms: £1 each way per combination: 15 win lines + 15 place lines. 1/4 odds place portion, paid places based on actual runner count. Not bookmaker terms.
lucky15Plan.recommendationStatus: Paper ticket proposed overnight; prices and non-runners require Friday verification
